papers.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models

training_data.name: Psy-Data-books
training_data.quote: The model's training on the Daemontatox/Psy-Data-books dataset, which is composed of professional psychiatric literature, textbooks, and clinical guidelines

training_method.update_scope_quote: This model is an 8-bit LoRA fine-tune

description.text: Compumacy-Experimental_MF is an advanced, experimental large language model fine-tuned to assist mental health professionals in clinical assessment and treatment planning. By leveraging the powerful unsloth/Qwen3-32B as its base, this model is designed to process complex clinical vignettes and generate structured, evidence-based responses that align with established diagnostic manuals and practice guidelines. This model is a research-focused tool intended to augment, not replace, the expertise of a licensed clinician. It systematically applies diagnostic criteria from the DSM-5-TR, references ICD-11 classifications, and cites peer-reviewed literature to support its recommendations.

serving.text_only_input_quote: clinical_vignette = "A 28-year-old male presents with a 6-month history of persistent low mood, anhedonia, significant weight loss, and early morning awakening."
serving.system_prompt: You are a licensed psychiatrist AI providing clinical assessments and recommendations. Apply DSM-5-TR diagnostic criteria systematically, reference ICD-11 classifications, and base all recommendations on peer-reviewed psychiatric literature.
serving.notes: The card example sets max_seq_length 4096 and max_new_tokens 2048, and loads Daemontatox/Compumacy-Experimental_MF rather than this repository. The published weights are 14 bfloat16 shards and there is no adapter_config.json. Per-device batch size is 2 with gradient accumulation 8 (effective batch size 16). The tokenizer pad token is <|vision_pad|>; the card's example is text.

discrepancies: Inventory method is lora. The card says an 8-bit LoRA fine-tune with bitsandbytes, which is LoRA on a quantized base. The card's loading example names Daemontatox/Compumacy-Experimental_MF, and the card title is Compumacy-Experimental_MF. The dataset id on the card, Daemontatox/Psy-Data-books, resolves to Compumacy/Psych_data.
